notes: Fiscal years end June 30; Q1 FY2027 is the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

Q1 FY2027: revenue $228M (AI Cloud $200M, Bitcoin mining $28M); adjusted EBITDA $66M; net loss $263M; stock-based compensation $106M; operating cash flow $529M including $645M of deferred revenue (customer prepayments); capex $4,824M (PP&E $2,131M, hardware $2,693M).

Revenue backlog $20.3B (+22% q/q), about two-thirds investment-grade counterparties. More than $4B ARR target moved from year-end 2026 to January 2027, possibly end of February, after a Microsoft-requested network design change and supplier timing.
Remaining FY2027 capex from September 30: $15B, of which $9B is covered by cash, committed GPU financing and prepayments and $6B is targeted from new financing. Capital commitments $18,947M.
At-the-market: 76.8M shares sold for about $3.7B gross under the $6.0B program by October 30, 2026. Mirantis acquired August 3, 2026 for about $538M, mostly 12.6M shares.
Effective interest rates (10-Q Note 19): GPU Financing 2.0 10.70%, GPU Financing 3.0 10.38%, DDTL 7.22%, USPP 7.09%, convertible notes 0.37-4.22%.

Potentially dilutive securities at September 30, 2026 (10-Q Note 22): RSUs 31.72M, Investment Rights 30.0M (terms not in the saved sources), options 5.05M (mostly out of the money), convertible notes 127.23M (2029/2030 notes about 29.7M at $13.64/$16.81). Outstanding plus RSUs and Investment Rights is about 486M.
